# PR Title

## Summary
- What problem does this PR solve? Why now?

## Changes
- Key implementation details and files touched.

## Screenshots / Recordings (UI)
- Optional visuals for UI changes.

## How To Test
1. Commands to run (e.g., `pnpm dev`, `pnpm worker:start`).
2. Steps to validate.

## Breaking Changes / Migrations
- Schema or API changes and required actions (e.g., `pnpm db:migrate`).

## Checklist
- [ ] Lint passes: `pnpm lint`
- [ ] Auto-fix applied when possible: `pnpm lint:fix`
- [ ] Typecheck passes: `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] Migrations generated/applied if schema changed
- [ ] Tests/scripts updated and passing
- [ ] Docs updated (README/AGENTS)
- [ ] Linked issues (e.g., Closes #123)
